company.name: Protective Insurance Company Limited
company.about: Protective Micro is one of four licensed micro non-life insurers in Nepal, licensed in 2023 and based in Dhangadhi. It sells small, affordable motor, property, personal accident and farm insurance, mainly to low-income households and farmers.
highlights: Largest of the four micro non-life insurers by premium (about NPR 311 million in the first 10 months of FY 2025/26)
Reinsured with Nepal Reinsurance and Himalayan Reinsurance
Province office in Lalitpur (01-5916790); claims email claim@protectivemicro.com

policies.name: Motor Insurance (Third Party)
policies.summary: Legally required cover that pays for injury or damage your bike causes to other people.
features: Fixed premium set by the NIA tariff
Claims can be reported by email or at a branch
benefits: Pays third-party death and injury claims as per tariff limits
Pays third-party property damage up to the tariff limit

pricing.note: Indicative third-party tariff, 150cc-250cc bike; check NIA tariff for your cc

bestFor: Any bike or scooter owner who needs the legal minimum cover

policies.name: Motor Insurance (Comprehensive)
policies.summary: Covers your own bike or scooter against accident and theft, plus third-party liability.
features: Premium is a percentage of the vehicle value
benefits: Compensation if the vehicle is stolen
bestFor: Owners of newer bikes who want repair and theft protection

policies.name: Personal Accident Insurance
policies.summary: Pays you or your family a lump sum if an accident causes injury, disability or death.
features: Simple claim process via branch or email
benefits: Medical expense help for accidental injury
exclusions: Injury from drunk or illegal activity

policies.name: Agriculture and Livestock Insurance
policies.summary: Protects crops, livestock and herbs against disease and weather losses.
benefits: Compensation for animal death from disease or accident
Compensation for crop loss from covered weather events

pricing.note: Indicative, per animal; actual premium depends on animal type and value

bestFor: Small farmers with cattle, buffalo or goats
